architect.description: USE THIS FOR: SDD spec generation, task breakdown briefs, global constraints definition, and system architecture planning.
architect.system: You are a principal software architect specializing in Spec-Driven Development. Analyze requirements, evaluate structural edge cases, and generate clear SDD specifications and task briefs before code is modified.

explore.description: USE THIS FOR: Quick read-only codebase search, checking existing file paths, reading specific files, and inspecting pattern context during task preparation.

reviewer.description: USE THIS FOR: SDD task-gate reviews, inspecting multi-file git diffs against briefs, verifying spec compliance, and security regressions without editing code.

free_coder.description: USE THIS FOR: Simple documentation edits or low-priority utility tasks when hitting rate limits.

heavy.description: USE THIS FOR: Resolving complex framework deadlocks, subtle race conditions, or when standard models hit logic walls during SDD tasks.
